items.claim: The records flag as an open, medium-severity risk that fragmented definitions, reporting formats and data systems had made it difficult to measure progress consistently and spotlight inequalities in India.
The Government of India launched the Swachh Bharat (Clean India) Mission in 2014, and 110 million toilets were constructed under it.
India reached 580 million people with improved drinking water and 550 million people with basic sanitation in the last 10 years.
In 2024, 59.3 million people in India were accessing safely managed water and 17.9 million were accessing safely managed sanitation.
India launched the Jal Jeevan (Water is Life) Mission to achieve universal access to safe and adequate drinking water.
The Government of India invested over $120 billion in water and sanitation.

narrative.claim: UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $9.326 billion in 2022, followed by $8.920 billion in 2023 and $8.263 billion in 2024.
UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $7.219 billion in 2020 and $8.122 billion in 2021.
In 2024 UNICEF's Core Resources income was $1.584 billion, which was 46% of total income.
UNICEF's 2024 Core Resources income included $724.9 million from the private sector, $512.6 million from the public sector and $346.1 million from other partners.
Other Resources Regular accounted for 49% of UNICEF's total income in 2024, and Other Resources Emergency accounted for 5%.
In India in 2024, safely managed water supplies were provided to 59.3 million people and sanitation services to 17.9 million people.

narrative.claim: UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $9.326 billion in 2022, flagged as a watch item.
UNICEF's total income from voluntary contributions was $8.920 billion in 2023 and $8.263 billion in 2024.
UNICEF's Core Resources income in 2024 was $1.584 billion, which was 46% of total income.
Core Resources income from the private sector in 2024 was $724.9 million, while income from the public sector was $512.6 million and from other partners was $346.1 million.
Other Resources Regular made up 49% of UNICEF's total income in 2024, and Other Resources Emergency made up 5%.
In India in 2024, safely managed water supplies were provided to 59.3 million people and sanitation services to 17.9 million people.
